Naturally, this dreary hospital setting offers nothing resembling proper comfort for a resting body.
Of course, the rain is tedious when one is already contemplating the futility of our existence.
Naturally, the environment remains a canvas of regrettable mediocrity.
Naturally, the cook has made a dreadful spectacle of himself once more.
Naturally, one wonders at the sudden, spectacular demise of proper furniture.
Of course he drops his tools at the gate because doing anything worthwhile is beneath him.
Naturally, the fog has brought us unwelcome company again.
Of course, my dear Ash, I have achieved a certain level of competence with this pathetic implement.
